preconditions.description: The number of bases n and the number of bases to remain k must satisfy 2 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 5 ⋅ 10^5.
Each base's coordinates (x, y) must satisfy -10^9 ≤ x, y ≤ 10^9.
The number of base coordinates provided must be equal to n.
One of the bases must be at the origin (0, 0).
No two bases can have the same coordinates.

postconditions.description: The output must be a floating-point number.
The maximal sum of distances must be non-negative.
The output must be within an absolute or relative error of 10^-6 compared to the expected output.
